summary: This informational document considers what happens to video distribution if the underlying network moves from today's Internet to an Information-Centric Networking architecture. Since most future traffic is expected to be video, it looks at how existing adaptive streaming mechanisms would need to change. It discusses several approaches and open issues.

eli5.summary: Watching a video online means asking a far-away computer for each piece. In a data-named network, any nearby copy can answer. This explores how video that adjusts its quality would work in such a network.
